summary: This clipped page is the navigation shell of the AGU Journals site (Wiley-hosted), not an article. Its content is a menu listing American Geophysical Union journals, including Space Weather, Earth's Future and Geophysical Research Letters, plus the Journal of Geophysical Research sub-journals and partnered titles. It also lists topic categories such as Atmospheric Composition, Biogeosciences, Geochemistry and Radio Science. The article body the page was clipped from is absent.
one_line: Navigation menu from the AGU Journals website listing its geophysics journals, partnered titles and topic categories.
key_facts: The clipped page is the AGU Journals website, labelled with the AGU Journals logo and hosted under agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com.
The journal menu lists AGU Advances, Community Science, Earth's Future, Earth and Space Science, and Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems.
The journal menu lists GeoHealth, Geophysical Research Letters, Global Biogeochemical Cycles, and Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems (JAMES).

The journal menu lists Paleoceanography and Paleoclimatology, Perspectives of Earth and Space Scientists, Radio Science, Reviews of Geophysics, Space Weather, Space Weather Quarterly, Tectonics, and Water Resources Research.
Water Resources Research is listed as 'Open Access as of January 2024' in the menu.
The Journal of Geophysical Research section of the menu lists Atmospheres, Biogeosciences, Earth Surface, Machine Learning and Computation, Oceans, Planets, Solid Earth, and Space Physics.
The menu lists the historical title Journal of Geophysical Research (1896-1977) alongside the current Journal of Geophysical Research sub-journals.
The partnered journals listed include Chinese Journal of Geophysics (2000-2018), Earth Interactions, Earth and Planetary Physics, and Geophysics.
Partnered journals also include International Journal of Geomagnetism and Aeronomy, Interpretation, Nonlinear Processes in Geophysics, and The Leading Edge.
The Topics menu groups journals under headings such as Atmospheric Composition, Biogeosciences, Education, and Engineering and Applied Geophysics.
Under Engineering and Applied Geophysics the Topics menu lists Electromagnetics and Radio Science.
Under Geochemistry, Mineralogy, Volcanology the Topics menu lists Geochemistry and Geochronology.
The page offers login options: Individual login, Institutional login, Log in with AGU, and Register.
The page's cookie banner links to the Wiley privacy policy (wiley.com/privacy).
